$comment: Shared cases for pruning the disk tile cache, run through BOTH implementations:
pruneTileCache in packages/map-sources/src/tilecache.ts and TileCache.Prune in
dotnet/JourneyBook.Infrastructure/Tiles/TileCache.cs. Both can own the same directory.
`files` are relative to the cache root with their size in bytes and age in hours;
`kept` is what must remain. `tmpMaxAgeHours` is 1 on both sides.

cases.why: A cache within its limit is not touched.
Age alone decides, across sources and zooms, and it stops as soon as the cache fits.
A temp file an hour old was abandoned by a crash; a newer one may be a write in progress. Neither counts as a tile.
A cache root pointed at the wrong directory must not delete what is not a tile, however old.
